pooling: attention-mask mean pooling, then L2 normalization
inference: local float32 eval, no instruction prefix, no training
aggregation: equal weight ten depth-by-position cell means; 1000 source-cluster bootstrap draws
regression: OLS Jaccard ~ AI + log1p(previous word count) + log1p(current word count), source-cluster robust CI; ten-cell weighted sensitivity
lexical_primary: NFKC casefold Unicode word tokens excluding sklearn ENGLISH_STOP_WORDS, set Jaccard; empty union=0
feedback: last actual feedback after previous query in recovered prefix; AI assistant text, TREC concatenated displayed titles/snippets. Missing feedback remains missing, not zero.
raw_text: Access through original releases; not distributed here.
output_schema: One row per side/source_key/position, aligned with comparison_pairs.json.
